name: CTC Data Center Nagoya Marunouchi (CTCデータセンター名古屋丸の内)
notes: Urban hyperscale-grade data center in Nagoya city center (Marunouchi), seismic-isolated structure with up to 1.5 t/sqm floor load; CTC operates three DC locations in Nagoya, including Nagoya Station South (opened Oct 2000); capacity not publicly stated.

name: Akita City AI data center plan (UAE-backed proposal)
developer: UAE government fund with US AI-related firm and Akita City IT companies (reported)
notes: Blog reporting that a UAE sovereign fund is considering up to about 1 trillion yen investment for an AI data center in Akita City with US AI and local IT companies, targeting operation in the first half of the 2030s; weak, unverified lead.

name: AirTrunk TOK1 hyperscale campus (Inzai)
notes: AirTrunk's first Japan data centre, TOK1 in Inzai (Chiba New Town area), opened November 2021 and is scalable to over 300 MW campus capacity; a 40+ MW new building (DC6/TOK1 AI expansion) broke ground and is under construction; TOK1 serves the Tokyo cloud availability zone.

name: NTT Shiroi Data Center SHR1 (Inzai-Shiroi area)
developer: NTT (with TEPCO Power Grid joint development in Inzai-Shiroi)
notes: First building of NTT's Shiroi campus (SHR1) expected to be completed by April 2027; NTT/TEPCO joint development targets the Inzai-Shiroi area (market reports cite a 50 MW scale); construction status and capacity still to be confirmed from primary NTT/TEPCO sources.

name: Colt Tokyo Inzai Data Centre 1 (Inzai 1)
notes: First of four planned sites on Colt's Tokyo Inzai campus in Chiba New Town; hyperscale facility designed to Colt tier 3 specification with 8 MW IT power and 4,000 sqm white space.

name: Digital Realty / MC Digital Realty NRT14 (Inzai NRT campus)
notes: Third data center on the NRT campus in Inzai, Chiba; 31 MW facility, construction underway with expected opening December 2025 (opening status to be re-verified).

name: NEC Inzai Data Center (Cloud Hub)
notes: NEC's cloud-hub data center in Inzai, Chiba, providing hybrid/multi-cloud connectivity to public and private clouds; operational; capacity not publicly stated.

name: Mitene Fukui Data Center (ふくいデータセンター)
notes: Hokuriku's first interconnection (IDC) data center in Fukui, opened May 2021; DR/BCP base with high availability, 24/365 monitoring; smaller regional facility, capacity not public.

name: Zerofield Hokuriku No.1 Data Center (Tsuruga)
notes: Company news: Zerofield opened a data center/office facility in Tsuruga, Fukui in July (year per article) with prefecture/city support, planning further investment; small facility, weak source grade.

name: IDC Frontier Fukuoka Kitakyushu Data Center
notes: Environmentally friendly next-generation data center in Kitakyushu, Fukuoka using outside-air conditioning; official IDC Frontier facility page; capacity not stated.

name: IDC Frontier Fukushima Shirakawa Data Center
notes: Official IDC Frontier data center in Shirakawa, Fukushima serving enterprises, government agencies and web operators, and a delivery point for IDC Frontier cloud services; capacity not stated.

name: Fujitsu Tatebayashi Data Center
notes: Fujitsu's Tatebayashi, Gunma data center focuses on hybrid cloud support, security and disaster resiliency; hosts Japan Meteorological Agency HPC systems with 100% uptime; site of Nidec/Fujitsu/SuperMicro energy-efficiency pilot targeting world-class PUE by Q4 FY2025.

name: EneWings Hiroshima Data Center (ATBeX-connected)
developer: EneWings (interconnected via AT TOKYO ATBeX platform)
notes: AT TOKYO announced (Jan 2023) EneWings Hiroshima Data Center linked with AT TOKYO data centers via the ATBeX platform and connected to the ATBeX Osaka zone with redundant 2-system configuration; local Hiroshima DC presence.

name: SoftBank Tomakomai AI Data Center
notes: SoftBank AI data center under construction in Tomakomai, Hokkaido on a ~700,000 sqm site; methodology notes first phase ~50 MW targeted for FY2026 with 300 MW+ longer-term potential (official announcement to be used as A-grade backfill); renewable-energy powered.

name: Sakura Internet Ishikari container data center
notes: Sakura Internet's Ishikari (Ishikari Bay New Port) flagship facility: container-type data center completed May 2025 (~3.5 MVA/40 racks per methodology) plus earlier Ishikari DC Building 3 (Dec 2016); NTT/Tokyu Land/Sakura consortium promotes Ishikari as a renewable-powered regional DC hub.

name: NEC Kobe Data Center
notes: NEC's Kobe data center offering colocation/outsourcing services with FISC and PCI DSS compliance; official NEC facility page; capacity not stated.
